sf-gazpacho-andaluz.s: Chop the tomatoes, cucumber and pepper and put them in the blender glass with the garlic and soaked bread. Grind until fine and, with the machine running, add the oil gradually so that it emulsifies. Adjust the vinegar and salt, strain if you want it very fine and chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

i: 2 hard-boiled eggs and 50 g of serrano ham to serve
sf-salmorejo-cordobes.s: Crush the tomatoes with the garlic and salt, add the bread in pieces and let it hydrate for a couple of minutes. Blend again, incorporating the oil little by little until you achieve a thick, orange cream. Cool and serve with chopped hard-boiled egg and ham on top.

sf-ajoblanco-malagueno.s: Soak the bread and grind it with the almonds, garlic and a little water until you obtain a paste. Add the rest of the water, vinegar and salt, and emulsify with the oil until smooth. Serve very cold with some split grapes on top.

i: hard boiled egg and ham to serve
sf-porra-antequerana.s: Blend the tomatoes with the garlic, pepper and salt, add the soaked bread and let it rest. Beat again, emulsifying with the oil until a cream thicker than gazpacho. Serve cold with hard-boiled egg and diced ham.

sf-gazpacho-verde.s: Peel and chop the cucumber, apple and avocado and put them in the blender with the pepper and spinach. Blend with the water and lime until you have a fine, green cream, emulsifying with the oil. Adjust the salt and serve very cold.

sf-gazpacho-sandia.s: Blend the watermelon with the tomato and cucumber until liquid. Emulsify with the oil and vinegar, add some mint leaves and salt, and beat again. Strain and serve very cold; It is sweet and refreshing.

i: 3 tablespoons natural yogurt or sour cream
salsa-ranch.s: Mix the mayonnaise with the yogurt and milk until it becomes a fluid cream. Add the garlic and onion powder, chives and dill, and season with salt and pepper. Let it rest for 30 minutes in the cold so that the flavors integrate.

salsa-bufalo.s: Melt the butter over low heat and remove from heat. Add the hot sauce, vinegar and garlic powder and whisk until emulsified and glossy. Use it warm on wings or roasted cauliflower.

salsa-tartara.s: Chop the pickles, capers and onion very finely. Mix them with the mayonnaise, mustard, parsley and lemon. Chill before serving; Accompanies fish and fried foods.

salsa-alfredo.s: Melt the butter with the minced garlic without browning. Add the cream and heat without boiling, add the parmesan little by little, stirring until it thickens. Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper and use immediately on pasta.

salsa-chipotle.s: Blend the chipotles with their marinade, garlic and lime until you obtain a paste. Mix it with the mayonnaise until you achieve the spiciness you prefer. Refrigerate; It goes well with tacos, hamburgers and potatoes.

i: a few mint or dill leaves
salsa-yogur-pepino.s: Grate the cucumber, salt it and drain it well to remove the water. Mix it with the yogurt, crushed garlic, oil, lemon and chopped herb. Chill 1 hour; refreshes grilled meats and vegetables.

i: 200 ml of milk or vegetable drink
sm-arandanos.s: Put all the ingredients in the blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Serves instantly; If you want it more liquid, add a little more milk.

i: 200 ml of milk or vegetable drink
sm-chocolate.s: Mash the banana with the milk, cocoa and peanut butter. Blend until thick and smooth. Sweeten with the date if you need it.

sm-melocoton.s: Peel and chop the peaches. Blend them with the yogurt, milk and honey until smooth. Serve cold.

sm-vainilla.s: Beat the banana with the yogurt, milk, vanilla and honey. Blend until you achieve a creamy smoothie texture. Serves immediately.

i: 200 ml of water or vegetable drink
sm-verde.s: Wash the spinach and chop the fruit. Blend everything with the water, ginger and lemon until it is fine and without strands. Drink freshly made to take advantage of the vitamins.

sm-fresa.s: Wash and trim the strawberries. Blend them with the yogurt, milk and honey until pink and foamy. Serve cold.

i: 250 ml of milk or vegetable drink
sm-platano.s: Mash the bananas with the milk, oats and cinnamon. Beat well until the oats are integrated and creamy. It is satiating, ideal before training.

sm-mango.s: Peel and chop the mango. Blend it with the yogurt, orange juice and honey until it is tropical and smooth. Serve very cold.

sm-sandia.s: Mash the watermelon with the strawberries, lime and mint. Add ice and blend until slushy. Very refreshing and low in calories.

sm-pina.s: Chop the pineapple and banana. Blend them with the coconut milk and water until you have a non-alcoholic piña colada-type drink. Serve with ice.

pl-ensalada-atun-garbanzos.s: Drain the chickpeas and tuna and mix them with the chopped tomato and onion. Dress with oil, vinegar, salt and parsley, and top with the hard-boiled egg in wedges. Holds up perfectly in a lunch box. It provides about 32 g of protein.

pl-wrap-pollo-aguacate.s: Spread the tortilla with the yogurt and distribute the lettuce, tomato, sliced ​​avocado and chicken. Roll tightly and wrap in paper to transport it. It provides about 38 g of protein.

pl-pasta-pollo-pesto.t: Cold pasta with chicken and pesto
pl-pasta-pollo-pesto.s: Cook the pasta al dente and cool it under the tap. Mix it with the pesto, shredded chicken, chopped cherries and arugula, and distribute the parmesan. It is eaten cold and provides about 36 g of protein.

pl-bowl-quinoa-salmon.s: Cook the quinoa and let it cool. Put it in the bowl with the salmon, avocado, carrot and edamame, and season with soy and sesame. It provides about 29 g of protein.

pl-hummus-verduras-huevo.s: Place the hummus in the center and distribute the raw vegetables on sticks around it. Add the broken hard-boiled eggs and a few peaks for dipping. It provides about 22 g of protein.

px-gilda.s: Thread an olive, a rolled chili pepper and an anchovy on a toothpick, repeating until the pintxo is assembled. Drizzle with a drizzle of olive oil. It is served cold as a salty and spicy appetizer.

px-tortilla-cremosa.s: Fry the sliced ​​potatoes and onion over low heat until tender and drain them. Mix them with the beaten eggs and set the omelette, leaving it juicy inside. Serve a piece on bread.

px-anchoa-piparra.s: Spread the bread with a little grated tomato and oil. Place the anchovies on top and accompany with the piparras. Saline and fresh bite at the same time.

px-bacalao-pilpil.s: Confit the garlic and chilli in the oil and remove them. Cook the cod over very low heat on the skin side and, off the heat, move the pot in circles to bind the pil pil with the fish gelatin. Serve on bread.

px-jamon-brie.s: Lightly toast the bread and place a slice of brie. Put the Iberian ham and a touch of jam on top. The contrast of salty and sweet is the key.

px-pulpo-gallega.s: Cut the octopus into slices and place it on a slice of cooked potato. Sprinkle paprika and salt flakes and drizzle with olive oil. Serve warm.

px-txaka.s: Crumble the surimi and mix it with the mayonnaise and fried tomato until you achieve a pink cream. Add a few drops of brandy. Serve on bread or in a tartlet.

px-croquetas.s: Make a thick bechamel with the butter, flour and milk, add the chopped ham and nutmeg and let it cool. Form the croquettes, dip them in egg and breadcrumbs and fry them in hot oil until golden brown.

px-boqueron-donostiarra.s: Cover the opened anchovies with vinegar and salt and let them marinate for a few hours in the cold until they turn white. Drain them and dress them with chopped garlic and parsley and plenty of olive oil. Serve very cold on bread.

px-solomillo-foie.s: Sear the grilled sirloin to perfection and season it with salt and pepper. Sear the foie for a few seconds on each side and mount it on the sirloin and bread. It ends with a reduction thread by Pedro Ximénez.

i: 200 g of crab or crab meat
px-txangurro.s: Sauté the onion and tomato, add the crab meat and brandy and let it reduce. Fill the shells or casseroles, sprinkle breadcrumbs with a few sheets of butter and gratin until golden.

px-atun-cebolla.s: Confit the julienne onion over low heat with a little sugar and vinegar until caramelized. Score the tuna on the outside, leaving it raw in the center and cut it into cubes. Serve on onion and bread.

px-morcilla-piquillos.s: Fry the crumbled black pudding until loose and crispy. Heat the piquillos in the same pan. Mount the blood sausage on the bread and the piquillo peppers on top.

px-salmon-ahumado.s: Spread the bread with the cream cheese and place the smoked salmon in folds. Decorate with dill and some capers. Fresh pintxo that does not need cooking.

px-cangrejos-vino.s: Sauté the onion and tomato, add the crab meat and pour over the white wine. Let it reduce until the sauce is smooth and sprinkle with parsley. Serve hot in a casserole or on bread.

ts-aguacate-huevo.s: Toast the bread and mash the avocado with salt on top. Poach the egg in water with a splash of vinegar for 3 minutes and place it on the avocado. Finish with flaked salt and pepper.

ts-jamon-burrata.t: Raw ham, burrata and tomato toast
ts-jamon-burrata.s: Place the open burrata on the bread and distribute the sliced ​​tomato. Add the ham and some basil leaves and drizzle with oil. Serve immediately so the burrata is creamy.

ts-salmon-aguacate.s: Spread the bread with cream cheese and spread the sliced ​​avocado. Arrange the salmon in folds and finish with dill and a few drops of lemon.

ts-cabra-miel.s: Place the cheese on the bread and gratin it for a few minutes until it turns golden. Drizzle with honey and scatter with chopped walnuts and thyme. Serve warm.

ts-atun-rabano.s: Mix the drained tuna with the mayonnaise and spread it on the bread. Top with thinly sliced ​​radishes and chopped chives.

ts-caprese.s: Spread alternating slices of mozzarella and tomato on the bread. Add basil leaves, salt and a drizzle of oil. Fresh and Mediterranean.

ts-salmon-eneldo.s: Spread the rye bread with cream cheese and place cucumber slices. Add the salmon and plenty of fresh dill.

ts-jamon-emmental.s: Spread the bread with mustard and place the cooked ham and emmental. Bake or gratin until the cheese melts.

ts-chorizo-manchego.s: Lightly fry the chorizo ​​to release its fat. Mount it on the bread with the manchego and a drizzle of oil. Heat until the cheese begins to melt.

ts-guacamole-gambas.s: Mash the avocado with lime, salt and cilantro and spread it on the bread. Sauté the shrimp with a little garlic and place them on top.

ts-pate-pepinillos.s: Spread the bread with the pate. Top with sliced ​​pickles and a little pickled onion to cut through the fat.

ts-queso-fresco-pepino.t: Fresh cheese, cucumber and dill toast
ts-queso-fresco-pepino.s: Spread the fresh cheese on the bread. Top with cucumber slices, dill and a pinch of salt. Light and refreshing.

ts-brie-pera-nueces.s: Place the brie on the bread and the sliced ​​pear on top. Spread walnuts and a drizzle of honey and lightly gratin.

ts-hummus-verduras.s: Spread bread generously with hummus. Place the warm roasted vegetables on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

ts-sardinas-tomate.s: Spread the bread with grated tomato and oil. Place the drained sardines on top and a pinch of salt.

ts-ricotta-miel-nueces.s: Spread the ricotta on the toasted bread. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with walnuts and a touch of cinnamon. Sweet and salty at the same time.

ts-pavo-mostaza.s: Spread the bread with mustard and place the lettuce, tomato and turkey. Light and quick option for mid-morning.

ts-azul-higo.t: Blue cheese, fig and walnut toast
ts-azul-higo.s: Spread the crumbled blue cheese over the bread. Add the fig segments, walnuts and a drizzle of honey to balance the strong flavor of the cheese.

ts-pan-tumaca.s: Toast the bread and rub it with the garlic and then with the chopped tomato. Water with good oil and salt. The basis of Mediterranean snacking.

ts-boquerones-pimiento.s: Place roasted pepper strips on the bread. Add the pickled anchovies and a drizzle of oil.

ts-queso-crema-salmon.s: Spread the cream cheese and place the salmon. Finish with capers and red onion in thin rings.

ts-revuelto-champinones.s: Sauté the sliced ​​mushrooms with garlic until golden brown and add the egg to make a juicy scramble. Spread over the bread with parsley.

ts-berenjena-feta.s: Grill sliced ​​eggplant in oil until tender. Place it on the bread with crumbled feta and mint.

ts-anchoas-mantequilla.s: Spread the bread with a layer of butter. Place the anchovies on top and sprinkle with chives. A simple French classic.

ts-tortilla-jamon.s: Make a juicy French omelette and fold it over the bread. Add the ham and a pinch of salt.

ap-brocheta-caprese.s: String a cherry, a basil leaf and a mozzarella on toothpicks. Dress with oil and a touch of balsamic. Ready in minutes.

ap-rollitos-calabacin.s: Cut the zucchini into thin slices lengthwise and mark them on the grill. Spread with cream cheese and mint, roll up and secure with a toothpick.

ap-huevos-rellenos.s: Cut the eggs in half and mix the yolks with the tuna and mayonnaise. Fill the egg whites with the pasta and decorate with a little fried tomato and olive.

ap-mini-quiches.s: Line muffin molds with the dough. Fill with the poached vegetables and the egg, cream and cheese mixture, and bake at 180°C for about 20 minutes.

ap-tartaletas-tomate.s: Fill the tartlets with tomato and cheese. Gratin until the cheese melts and sprinkle with oregano.

ap-brocheta-melon-jamon.s: Cut the melon into cubes and wrap them with half a slice of ham. String a mint leaf onto toothpicks. Sweet and salty.

ap-palmeritas-pesto.s: Spread the pesto over the puff pastry and roll both sides towards the center. Cut into slices, sprinkle with parmesan and bake until golden.

ap-champinones-rellenos.s: Remove the stems from the mushrooms and chop them. Mix them with cream cheese, garlic and parsley, fill the hats, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake for 15 minutes.

ap-bolitas-queso.s: Mix the cheeses and form balls with your hands. Coat them in herbs and chopped nuts and chill until serving.

ap-brocheta-pollo-pina.s: Marinate the diced chicken with soy and honey. Skewer it alternating with pineapple and grill it; sprinkle sesame.

ap-cherry-atun.s: Empty the cherries carefully. Fill them with tuna mixed with mayonnaise and finish with chives.

ap-rollitos-salmon.s: Spread the salmon slices, spread cream cheese with dill and roll them up. Cut into sushi-style slices.

ap-crackers-pate.s: Spread each cracker with pate. Top with a slice of pickle. Fast and result.

ap-datiles-bacon.s: Fill each date with an almond and wrap it with half a slice of bacon. Bake until the bacon is crispy.

ap-bruschetta-tomate.s: Toast baguette slices and rub them with garlic. Cover with chopped tomato seasoned with basil, oil and salt.

ap-pinchos-caprese.s: Alternate cherry, basil and mozzarella on each toothpick. Water with a balsamic reduction.

ap-pepino-feta.s: Cut the cucumber into thick slices and place a cube of feta and half an olive on top. Secure with a toothpick and sprinkle with oregano.

i: thick bechamel with 50 g of ham
ap-croquetas-jamon.s: Form the croquettes with the cold bechamel and ham dough. Coat them in egg and breadcrumbs and fry them until golden.

ap-aceitunas-marinadas.s: Mix the olives with sliced ​​garlic, citrus peels, thyme and oil. Marinate for at least a day in the refrigerator.

ap-hummus-cruidites.s: Serve the hummus in a bowl in the center. Serve with raw vegetable sticks and dippers.

en-griega.s: Chop the tomato, cucumber and onion into large pieces. Add the diced feta and olives, and dress with oil and oregano. It doesn't have lettuce.

en-col.s: Cut the cabbage and carrot into very fine julienne strips. Mix the mayonnaise with the vinegar and mustard and season it. Let it rest to soften.

en-tomate-cebolla.s: Cut the tomatoes into slices and the onion into feathers. Dress with oil, vinegar and salt and sprinkle with oregano.

en-pepino-yogur.s: Cut the cucumber into thin slices. Mix it with the yogurt, crushed garlic, mint and salt. Serve very cold.

en-remolacha.s: Cut the beet into cubes and mix it with the onion. Spread goat cheese and walnuts and season.

en-cesar.s: Grill the chicken and cut it into strips. Mix the lettuce with the Caesar sauce, add the chicken, croutons and flaked Parmesan.

en-patata.s: Cook the potatoes and cut them into cubes. Mix them with the egg, onion and chopped pickles and mix with mayonnaise.

en-pasta.s: Cook the pasta al dente and cool it. Mix it with the cherries, mozzarella and olives and dress with oil and basil.

en-arroz.s: Cook the rice and cool it. Mix it with the tuna, corn, pepper, egg and olives and season.

en-lentejas.s: Drain the lentils and mix them with the chopped tomato, onion and pepper. Dress with oil, vinegar and a pinch of cumin.

en-quinoa.s: Cook the quinoa and let it cool. Mix it with the cucumber, tomato and diced avocado and season with lime, cilantro and oil.

en-garbanzos.s: Mix the chickpeas with the chopped tomato, cucumber and onion. Dress with oil, lemon, parsley and cumin.

en-salmon-aguacate.s: Arrange the leaves on the plate and distribute the salmon, the sliced ​​avocado and the cherries. Dress with oil, lemon and dill.

en-cabra-nueces.s: Gratin slices of goat cheese and place them on the leaves. Scatter walnuts and dress with honey, balsamic and oil.

en-jamon-melon.s: Arrange the arugula with the diced melon and ham. Finish with flakes of parmesan and a drizzle of oil.

en-pollo-mango.s: Score the chicken and cut it into strips. Mount it on the leaves with the mango and diced avocado and cashews, and dress with lime vinaigrette.

en-tofu-sesamo.s: Brown the diced tofu. Mix it with the julienned cabbage and carrot and the edamame, and season with soy, sesame oil and seeds.

en-verano.s: Cut the watermelon into cubes and mix it with the feta and olives. Dress with oil, lemon and mint. Sweet and salty.

en-otono.s: Roast the diced pumpkin until golden brown. Mount it warm on the spinach with nuts, cheese and seeds and dress with honey vinaigrette.

en-invierno.s: Peel the oranges roughly and slice the fennel very finely. Mix them with the olives and pomegranate and season with oil and salt.

en-primavera.s: Sauté the asparagus and peas and let them cool. Mount them on the arugula with a poached egg and parmesan, and dress with oil and lemon.

en-frutas.s: Cut all the fruit into similar sizes. Mix it with the orange juice so that it does not oxidize and distribute some mint leaves.

po-tiramisu.s: Separate the whites from the yolks. Beat the yolks with the sugar until they turn white and add the mascarpone until you have a smooth cream. Whip the egg whites until stiff and fold them in with gentle movements. Briefly dip the biscuits in the coffee and form a layer on a platter; cover with cream and repeat. Finish with sprinkled cocoa and chill for at least 4 hours.

i: butter and cocoa for the molds
po-coulant-chocolate.s: Melt the chocolate with the butter and let it cool. Beat the eggs with the sugar and add the chocolate, sifted flour and salt. Pour into individual greased molds and chill for 30 minutes. Bake at 200°C for about 9-10 minutes: the edge should be set and the center runny. Carefully unmold and serve immediately.

po-cheesecake.s: Crush the cookies and mix them with the melted butter; Press into the base of a mold and cool. Beat the cheese with the sugar and vanilla, whip the cream separately and fold it in gently. Pour over the base, smooth and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Top with berries before serving.

po-panna-cotta.s: Hydrate the gelatin in cold water. Heat the cream with the sugar and vanilla without boiling, remove from the heat and dissolve the drained gelatin. Pour into glasses and chill for at least 4 hours until set. Crush some red berries with a little sugar and cover the panna cotta before serving.

po-mousse-chocolate.s: Melt the chocolate and let it cool. Separate the whites from the yolks and add the yolks to the chocolate. Whip the egg whites with the salt and, when they are foamy, add the sugar until a firm meringue. Integrate the meringue into the chocolate with enveloping movements so as not to lower it. Pour into glasses and chill for at least 3 hours.

i: the juice of 3 lemons and the zest of 1
po-tarta-limon.s: Bake the blank shortcrust pastry base at 180°C for about 15 minutes. Mix the eggs with the sugar, lemon juice, zest and cornstarch, and cook over low heat, stirring until thickened. Remove, add the butter in pieces and fill the base. Chill until set and serve cold.

i: cream and red fruits to fill
po-crepes.s: Beat the eggs with the milk, flour, sugar and salt until a thin dough without lumps; Let it rest for 20 minutes. Grease a frying pan and pour a ladle, spreading it thinly; curdle for a minute on each side. Fill with cream and red berries, fold and sprinkle with sugar.

i: 250 ml of milk or vegetable drink
red fruits and yogurt to whip
po-budin-chia.s: Mix the chia with the milk, honey and vanilla and stir well so that it does not clump. Let it rest in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours (preferably overnight), stirring once halfway through. Pour into glasses alternating with yogurt and red fruits.

i: the zest of 2 lemons and their juice
icing sugar and lemon juice for the glaze
po-bundt-limon.s: Beat the eggs with the sugar until they double in volume. Add the oil, yogurt, lemon zest and juice. Add the sifted flour and yeast. Pour into a greased bundt pan and bake at 175°C for about 40 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Unmold, let cool and cover with a icing sugar and lemon glaze.

po-pavlova.s: Whip the egg whites and add the sugar several times until a firm and shiny meringue; Add the cornstarch and vinegar. Form a disk on baking paper and bake at 120°C for about 70 minutes; Let it cool in the turned off oven. Top with whipped cream and berries just before serving.

po-sorbete-limon.s: Heat the water with the sugar until it dissolves and let this syrup cool. Mix it with the juice and lemon zest. Freeze in a container, stirring with a fork every 30-40 minutes to break up the crystals; For a softer texture, add the half-frozen whipped egg white. It is ready when it is firm but creamy.

i: cinnamon powder and cookies to serve
po-natillas.s: Infuse the milk with the cinnamon stick and lemon peel and remove it before it boils. Beat the yolks with the sugar and cornstarch, add the warm and strained milk and cook over low heat, stirring until it thickens without boiling. Divide into bowls, sprinkle with cinnamon and serve with a cookie.

dip-hummus.s: Drain the chickpeas, reserving a little of the liquid. Grind them with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt until a paste. Add the oil and a little cold water while beating until creamy. Serve with a drizzle of oil and paprika.

dip-guacamole.s: Open the avocados and mash them with a fork, leaving some texture. Mix with the finely chopped onion, tomato, cilantro and chili. Dress with lime juice and salt. Serve it freshly so it doesn't oxidize.

i: a few mint or dill leaves
dip-tzatziki.s: Grate the cucumber, salt it and drain it well, squeezing to remove the water. Mix it with the yogurt, grated garlic, oil and vinegar. Add the chopped mint and salt, and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

dip-baba-ganoush.s: Roast the whole aubergines in the oven at 200°C for about 40 minutes until very soft. Let it cool, remove the skin and drain the pulp. Crush or crush it with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice and salt. Serve with oil and parsley on top.

dip-pico-gallo.s: Chop the tomatoes, onion and chili into very small cubes. Mix them with the cilantro, lime juice and salt. Let it rest for 10 minutes for the flavors to integrate before serving.

dip-alioli.s: Put the egg, garlic, lemon and salt in the blender glass. Cover with the oil and beat with the mixer attached to the bottom without moving it until emulsified. Raise slowly to integrate all the oil until you achieve a firm sauce. Keep it cold.

i: 1 tablespoon pomegranate molasses (or a little vinegar)
dip-muhammara.s: Crush the roasted and peeled peppers with the walnuts, bread, cumin and pomegranate molasses. Add the oil gradually until a thick paste and adjust the salt. Serve with a little more oil and chopped nuts.

dip-tapenade.s: Chop the olives, capers, anchovies and garlic. Grind them with the oil and lemon until a rustic paste, not too fine. Use it on toasted bread or as an accompaniment.

cf-vichyssoise.s: Sauté the chopped leek and onion in the butter without letting them color. Add the potato pieces and broth, and cook for 20 minutes until tender. Blend very finely, add the cream and season with salt and pepper. Chill for at least 3 hours and serve with chopped chives.

cf-remolacha.s: Blend the beets with the yogurt, garlic, lemon and water until a fine cream. Emulsify with the oil and salt and pepper. Cool well and serve with a little yogurt and dill on top.

i: 200 ml of broth or cold water
cf-aguacate.s: Puree the avocados with the peeled cucumber, yogurt, lime and broth until smooth. Add the cilantro and salt and pepper. Serve very cold; If it thickens, rinse with a little more water.

cf-calabacin.s: Sauté the onion and zucchini pieces in the oil for a few minutes. Add the broth and cook for 15 minutes. Blend with the cheese until a fine cream, season with salt and pepper and cool. Serve cold with a drizzle of oil.

cf-zanahoria.s: Sauté the sliced ​​onion and carrot in the oil. Add the broth and ginger and cook for 20 minutes. Blend with the orange juice until a fine cream, season with salt and pepper and cool. Serve cold.

cf-guisantes-menta.s: Sauté the spring onion, add the peas and broth and cook for 10 minutes. Blend with the mint until a fine cream and strain if you want. Season with salt and pepper, cool and serve with a spoonful of yogurt.

i: 50 g of serrano ham to serve
cf-melon-jamon.s: Blend the melon with the water, oil and salt until a fine cream. Cools well. Serve with some shavings of Serrano ham and some mint leaves.

cf-pepino-yogur.s: Blend the peeled cucumbers with the yogurt, garlic, lemon and oil until creamy. Add dill and salt and pepper. Cool well and serve; It is very refreshing in summer.

cf-calabaza.s: Sauté the onion, carrot and pumpkin in pieces. Add the broth and cook for 20 minutes until tender. Blend with the nutmeg until a fine cream, season with salt and pepper and cool. Serve cold with a drizzle of oil.

cf-esparragos.s: Sauté the leek and potato, add the chopped asparagus (reserve the tips) and the broth, and cook for 15 minutes. Grind very fine and season with salt and pepper. Skip the reserved tips and use them to decorate. Serve cold.

hv-tortilla-espanola.s: Peel and cut the potatoes into thin slices (and the onion into julienne strips). Fry them over medium heat in plenty of oil until they are tender, drain them and salt them. Beat the eggs, mix them with the potato and set the omelette in a frying pan with a little oil, turning it over with a plate. Leave it juicy inside.

hv-tortilla-francesa.s: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Heat the oil in a small frying pan, pour in the egg and, when it starts to set around the edges, collect it towards the center. Roll it on itself and serve juicy. Add cheese or parsley to taste.

hv-huevos-rotos.s: Cut the potatoes into sticks and fry them until golden and tender. Fry the eggs in hot oil, leaving the yolk liquid. Place the eggs on the potatoes, break them and mix. Add ham or chorizo ​​if you want.

hv-revuelto-setas.s: Sauté the chopped mushrooms with garlic and a little oil until they release their water and turn golden brown. Lower the heat, add the beaten eggs and stir constantly until they become creamy. Season with salt and pepper and finish with parsley.

hv-shakshuka.s: Sauté the onion, pepper and garlic. Add the tomato, cumin and paprika and cook for 10 minutes until thickened. Make holes and crack the eggs inside; Cover and cook over low heat until the whites are set and the yolk is liquid. Serve with herbs.

hv-huevos-rellenos.s: Cook the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel them. Cut them in half and remove the yolks. Mix the yolks with the tuna, mayonnaise and tomato until a paste. Fill the egg whites with the mixture and decorate with a little more mayonnaise.

i: 2 English muffins or slices of bread
2 yolks, 100 g of butter, lemon juice and salt for the hollandaise
hv-huevos-benedictinos.s: Poach the eggs in water with vinegar for about 3 minutes. Toast the bread and heat the bacon. Prepare the hollandaise by beating the yolks in a bain-marie and adding the melted butter and lemon until it thickens. Assemble the bread with the bacon, the poached egg and the sauce on top.

hv-tortilla-calabacin.s: Sauté the sliced ​​zucchini with the onion and a little oil until tender. Beat the eggs, mix them with the drained vegetables and set the omelette on both sides in the pan. Leave it juicy.

ce-paella-valenciana.s: Heat the oil in the leveled paella pan and fry the chicken and rabbit until golden brown on all sides. Add the Bajoqueta and the Garrofon, sauté for a few minutes and move the meat to the sides to sauté the grated tomato until the water evaporates; Add the paprika and, without burning, cover with water. Add the saffron, rosemary and salt, and boil hard for 20 minutes to make the broth; remove the rosemary, distribute the rice in the shape of a cross and then over the entire surface. Cook for 8 minutes over high heat and another 8-10 over low heat without stirring, and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

ce-fabada-asturiana.s: Soak the beans in cold water for 12 hours and soak the pork separately. Drain them and put them in a large pot with the compango (chorizo, blood sausage, lacón and bacon), cover with cold water two fingers above and bring to a boil, removing the foam. Add the saffron, reduce to low and cook very slowly for about two and a half hours, "scaring" the beans with a splash of cold water a couple of times so they don't break. Move the pot by the handles instead of stirring with a spoon, adjust the salt and serve hot with the chopped compango.

i: 1 suckling pig of about 4 kg open in carcass
ce-cochinillo.s: Salt it inside with coarse salt and spread it with a thin layer of butter. Place some wooden slats in the bottom of a clay pot, add a glass of water and the bay leaf, and place the suckling pig skin side down on the wood. Roast at 160ºC for around an hour and a quarter, making sure there is no lack of water; Turn it over with the skin facing up, prick it with a needle and spread it with butter. Increase to 190ºC and roast for another hour until the skin is golden brown and so crispy that it breaks to the touch.

ce-pisto-manchego.s: Cut all the vegetables into regular cubes of approximately one centimeter. Sauté the onion with a pinch of salt in a good amount of oil over low heat for about 10 minutes, add the peppers and sauté for another 10. Add the zucchini and fry for 5-7 minutes without breaking down, and add the crushed tomato with the salt and sugar. Cook uncovered over low heat for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomato reduces and the oil floats to the surface.

i: olive or sunflower oil for frying
ce-churros.s: Bring the water and salt to a boil in a saucepan and, as soon as it comes to a boil, pour in all the flour at once. Remove from the heat and stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until you obtain a homogeneous mass that comes away from the walls. Put the dough in a churrera and press it so that it falls directly onto the hot oil at 190ºC, forming strips or bows. Fry until golden and crispy, drain on absorbent paper and sprinkle with sugar before serving.

ce-crema-catalana.s: Dissolve the cornstarch in a reserved glass of cold milk and heat the rest of the milk with the cinnamon and lemon and orange peels; When it boils, set aside and let it infuse for 10 minutes. Beat the yolks with 150 g of sugar until white and add the milk with the dissolved cornstarch. Strain the hot infused milk over the mixture and bring everything to a simmer, stirring constantly until it thickens, without boiling. Pour into small clay pots, cool in the refrigerator and, before serving, sprinkle with the remaining sugar and burn with a blowtorch until caramelized.

ro-sarmale.s: Sauté the chopped onion and mix it with the meat, raw rice, paprika, salt and pepper. Separate the cabbage leaves, trim the rib and put a little filling in each one; roll them up, tucking in the sides. Place the rolls tightly in a pot on a bed of chopped cabbage and bacon, cover with the tomato, thyme and water, and cook covered over very low heat for 2-3 hours (or in the oven). They are served with polenta and sour cream.

i: 150 g fresh Romanian cheese (telemea) or feta
ro-mamaliga.s: Bring the salted water to a boil and add the corn flour in a stream, stirring constantly with a whisk so that lumps do not form. Cook over medium heat for 20-30 minutes, stirring often, until it comes away from the walls. Serve the polenta hot with the crumbled cheese, a tablespoon of sour cream and butter.

ro-mici.s: Mix the two meats with the crushed garlic, cumin, paprika, baking soda, salt and pepper, and add the cold broth little by little until a sticky dough. Let it rest covered in the refrigerator for a few hours (preferably overnight). Form into thick finger-sized rolls and grill them very hot, turning, until golden brown on the outside and juicy. Serve with mustard and bread.

i: fried eggs and polenta to serve
ro-tochitura.s: Brown the bacon and pork in a saucepan with a little butter. Add the chopped onion and garlic and sauté. Add the tomato, bay leaf and water to cover, season with salt and pepper and cook over low heat for 1 hour until the meat is tender and the sauce is concentrated; add the sliced ​​sausage at the end. Serve with polenta and a fried egg on top.

ro-ardei-umpluti.s: Sauté the onion and mix it with the meat, rice, herbs, salt and pepper. Empty the peppers of seeds and fill them loosely (the rice grows). Place them standing up in a pot, cover them with the tomato and the grated carrot with water, and cook, covered, over low heat for 45-60 minutes. Serve with a dollop of sour cream.

ro-ciorba-perisoare.s: Cook the onion, carrots, parsnip and diced pepper in salted water. Mix the meat with the rice and a little onion, form small meatballs and add them to the boiling soup; cook 20 minutes. Sour the soup with the borș (or lemon) and boil for a couple more minutes. Finish with plenty of chopped parsley and lovage.

ro-salata-boeuf.s: Cook the meat and, separately, the potatoes and carrots; let it cool. Cut everything into very small cubes along with the pickles and mix it with the peas, mayonnaise, mustard and salt. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours and serve very cold, smoothed and decorated with pickle or pepper.

ro-chiftele.s: Mix the meat with the grated and drained potato, grated onion, garlic, egg, dill, salt and pepper. Form somewhat flattened balls, dredge them in flour and fry them in hot oil until golden on both sides and cooked on the inside. Drain on paper and serve hot or cold.

ro-ostropel-pui.s: Brown the chicken pieces in oil and set them aside. In the same saucepan, sauté the flour for a minute, add the tomato, crushed garlic, salt and pepper and a little water. Return the chicken, cover and simmer for 30-40 minutes until tender and the sauce is thick and very melted. Sprinkle parsley and serve with polenta or bread.

i: 200 g of smoked ribs or bacon
ro-cartofi-taranesti.s: Brown the rib in cubes and set it aside. Sauté the onion, garlic and pepper in the fat. Add the potato wedges, paprika and thyme, season with salt and pepper and add a little water. Return the meat, cover and cook over medium heat (or in the oven) until the potatoes are tender and melty.

ro-ciorba-burta.s: Cook the bone in plenty of salted water, foaming often, add the onion, celery and a whole carrot and cook until you achieve a clear broth; strain it. Add the tripe cut into thin strips to the strained broth and cook for 30 minutes, adding the other grated and sautéed carrot to give color. Beat the yolks with the cream, temper the mixture by adding ladles of hot broth and pour it into the pot off the heat so that it does not curdle. Add a crushed strain of garlic, sour with vinegar to taste and adjust the salt.

ro-ciorba-radauteana.s: Cook the chicken in foaming salted water, along with the whole vegetables, until the meat falls off the bone. Take out the meat, shred it into thin strips and strain the broth (the vegetables are no longer used); return it to the pot with the meat. Beat the yolks with the cream and flour, temper the mixture with ladles of hot broth and pour it in, stirring constantly. Add the crushed garlic and vinegar, bring to a boil and remove from the heat.

ro-salata-vinete.s: Roast whole eggplants over a flame or grill until the skin is charred and the flesh is very soft. Peel them while hot and let them drain on a tilted board for an hour to release the bitter juice. Chop them with a wooden knife (avoid metal so they don't rust) and beat them with a spoon, incorporating the oil in a stream, like mayonnaise, until they are creamy. Salt them and add the chopped onion just before serving, with bread.

i: 1 kg of cooked forest mushrooms (or roasted eggplants)
2 kg roasted and peeled red kapia peppers
ro-zacusca.s: Finely chop or crush the cooked mushrooms and roasted peppers, already peeled and seeded. Sauté the chopped onion in all the oil over low heat until it is transparent and melty. Add the peppers and mushrooms, stirring so they don't stick, and add the tomato, bay leaf, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat for 2-3 hours, stirring occasionally, until the paste thickens and the oil rises to the surface; pack hot.

cq-jamon.s: Melt the butter, sauté the ham for a minute and add the flour; cook it for 2 minutes. Pour in the hot milk little by little, stirring constantly until you have a thick, smooth béchamel; season with nutmeg, salt and pepper. Spread it on a platter, cover it tightly and chill for several hours. Form the croquettes, dip them in egg and breadcrumbs and fry them in hot oil until golden brown.

i: 250 g shredded cooked or roast chicken
cq-pollo.s: Sauté the finely chopped onion in the butter, add the chicken and flour and sauté for 2 minutes. Add the hot milk several times, stirring until a thick béchamel is formed; season with nutmeg. Cool the dough well covered, form the croquettes, coat them with egg and breadcrumbs and fry them golden.

cq-bacalao.s: Sauté the chopped garlic and cod in the butter, add the flour and cook for 2 minutes. Pour in the hot milk little by little until a thick bechamel; Adjust salt (be careful, the cod is already salted), nutmeg and parsley. Cool covered, form croquettes, coat them in egg and breadcrumbs and fry them golden.

cq-espinacas.s: Sauté the garlic and well-drained and chopped spinach with the pine nuts. Add the flour, sauté and pour the hot milk little by little until a thick bechamel; season with nutmeg. Chill the dough, form the croquettes, bread them and fry them until golden brown.

i: 120 g of grated cured or blue cheese
cq-queso.s: Prepare a thick bechamel: melt the butter, cook the flour for 2 minutes and add the hot milk, stirring. Off the heat, add the cheese until it melts and season with nutmeg, salt and pepper. Cool well covered, form the croquettes, coat them with egg and breadcrumbs and fry them golden.

cq-setas.s: Sauté the finely chopped onion and mushrooms until they lose their water and turn golden. Add the flour, sauté for 2 minutes and pour in the hot milk little by little until a thick bechamel; season with nutmeg. Chill the dough, form the croquettes, bread them and fry them crispy.

i: 250 g shredded stew or stew meat
cq-cocido.s: Take advantage of the finely chopped stew meats. Sauté the onion in the butter, add the meat and flour and sauté. Add the hot milk little by little until a thick bechamel; season with nutmeg. Cool covered, form croquettes, coat them with egg and breadcrumbs and fry them golden.

cq-gambas.s: Boil the shrimp shells for a few minutes for a short broth. Sauté the onion, sauté the chopped shrimp, add the flour and sauté. Pour in the hot milk and broth little by little until a thick bechamel; season with nutmeg and salt. Cool the dough, form the croquettes, bread them and fry them golden.

lm-clasica.s: Squeeze the lemons and mix the juice with the water. Dissolve the sugar while stirring and taste to adjust the sweetness. Serve very cold with ice and a few lemon slices.

lm-fresa.s: Mash the strawberries with a little water and strain if you want a clean texture. Mix them with the lemon juice, the rest of the water and sugar to taste. Serve very cold with ice.

lm-menta-pepino.s: Blend the cucumber with the mint and a little water and strain. Mix with the lemon juice, the rest of the water and the sweetener. Serve with ice, cucumber slices and mint leaves.

lm-naranjada.s: Squeeze the oranges and lemon. Mix the juices with the water and sweeten to taste (the oranges already provide sweetness). Serve very cold with ice and orange slices.

lm-agua-sandia.s: Mash the watermelon and strain the juice. Mix it with the water and lime, and sweeten only if necessary. Serve very cold with ice and, if you like, mint leaves.

lm-te-melocoton.s: Infuse the tea in the hot water for 4-5 minutes and let it cool. Mash the peach with a little water and mix it with the tea, sweetener and lemon. Serve very cold with ice and peach slices.

lm-horchata.s: Soak the tiger nuts in water for 12 hours, drain them and grind them with the liter of water. Let it rest for 1-2 hours and strain with a cloth, squeezing well. Sweeten with sugar, perfume with lemon and cinnamon and cool. Serve very cold, stirring before.

lm-mojito-sin.s: Mash the lime into wedges with the mint and sugar at the bottom of the glass to release the aromas. Fill with crushed ice and top off with sparkling water. Stir and decorate with mint and lime.

lm-jamaica.s: Boil the water, remove from the heat and add the hibiscus flower; Let it infuse for 10-15 minutes. Strain, sweeten with sugar and add the lemon. Cool and serve with ice.

i: 500 g cottage cheese (urdă) or fresh cheese
sour cream and blueberry jam to serve
pr-papanasi.s: Mix the cottage cheese with the eggs, zest, salt, flour and yeast until a manageable dough. Form balls with a hole in the center (like a donut) and a small ball on the side. Fry them in not very hot oil until they float golden brown. Serve them hot with sour cream on top and blueberry jam, topped with the ball.

i: for the filling: 150 g of ground walnuts, 50 g of sugar, 2 tablespoons of cocoa, 1 egg white
pr-cozonac.s: Activate the yeast in the milk with a tablespoon of sugar. Knead with the flour, sugar, eggs, zest and butter until a smooth and elastic dough; let rise 1 hour. Mix the nuts with the sugar, cocoa and egg white. Stretch the dough, spread the filling, roll, braid two rolls and place them in a mold. Let it rise again and bake at 170°C for about 40-45 minutes.

pr-gogosi.s: Activates yeast in milk with sugar. Knead with the flour, eggs, sugar, zest and salt until a soft dough; let rise 1 hour. Stretch, cut discs and let them rest for 15 minutes. Fry them in plenty of oil over medium heat, turning them until they puff up and brown. Drain them and sprinkle with icing sugar.

i: hazelnut jam or cream to fill
pr-clatite.s: Beat the eggs with the milk, sugar and salt and add the flour until a fluid dough without lumps; Let it rest for 20 minutes. Set thin crepes in a buttered pan, browning them on both sides. Fill them with jam or cream, roll them up and sprinkle sugar.

i: 1 sheet of filo or puff pastry
pr-placinta-mere.s: Grate the apples and sauté them with the sugar and cinnamon until they lose their water; Add the breadcrumbs to absorb the juice. Brush the dough sheets with butter, spread the filling, roll or assemble in layers in a dish and brush on top. Bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes until golden. Serve warm with icing sugar.

pr-orez-lapte.s: Cook the rice for a couple of minutes in water and drain it. Add it to the hot milk with the sugar, cinnamon stick and zest, and cook over low heat, stirring often, for about 25-30 minutes until creamy. Serve cold or warm with cinnamon powder.

pr-budinca-gris.s: Heat the milk with the sugar and vanilla and add the semolina in rain, stirring until it thickens. Remove, temper and add the beaten egg. Pour into a buttered mold and bake at 180°C for about 25 minutes (or set in flan pans). Serve warm or cold with jam.

pr-salam-biscuiti.s: Cut the cookies into irregular pieces. Heat the milk with the sugar, cocoa and butter until a smooth cream and mix it with the cookies and nuts. Form a cylinder with film, roll it tightly and chill in the refrigerator for several hours. Cut into slices that imitate salami; coat in icing sugar if you want.
